title: Experiential Reinforcement Learning
reasoning: The paper introduces a reinforcement learning training paradigm for Large Language Models called Experiential Reinforcement Learning (ERL). Its focus is on improving learning efficiency and performance in control environments and agentic reasoning tasks (Sokoban, FrozenLake, HotpotQA) and does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, theology, morals, or ethics.
